criterion: Spec section 13.3: do not choose best.pt vs last.pt based on test robustness; use a predeclared validation-time rule.

per_defense_rule.D0_standard: best.pt (Ultralytics clean-fitness selection) -- no robustness objective during training, so clean-fitness selection is the correct rule, not an instance of the anti-pattern.
per_defense_rule.D1_pgd_at: last.pt -- predeclared from a PRIOR finding on record (this project's own best.pt-vs-last.pt comparison on the leakage-safe split): last.pt is substantially more PGD-20-robust than best.pt for this adversarially-trained checkpoint. Decided before this evaluation ran, not fit to this evaluation's outcome.
per_defense_rule.D2_random_swir_aug: robust_best.pt -- selected during training by RobustCheckpointSelector, S=0.5*mAP_clean+0.5*mAP_robust(SNUA-GO weak, 5 steps), tracked every epoch.

training_time_robust_probe_attack: SNUA-GO weak severity, 5 steps (cheap; distinct from the 20-step evaluation-time attacks used in the final matrix)
